mapper.select: SELECT 'USER' AS targetType, CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT(IFNULL(u.real_name, '-'), '（', u.username, '）') AS targetName, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, CONCAT('可见菜单 ', COUNT(DISTINCT rm.menu_id), ' 个，达到阈值 ', #{threshold}, '；角色：', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_name SEPARATOR '、')) AS detail FROM agri_md_user_role ur JOIN agri_md_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.del_flag = 0 JOIN agri_md_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = 0 JOIN agri_md_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id AND rm.del_flag = 0 AND (rm.expire_time IS NULL OR rm.expire_time > NOW()) JOIN agri_md_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.del_flag = 0 WHERE ur.del_flag = 0 AND (ur.expire_time IS NULL OR ur.expire_time > NOW()) GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name, u.username, u.tenant_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rm.menu_id) >= #{threshold} ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT rm.menu_id) DESC

SELECT 'USER' AS targetType, CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT(IFNULL(u.real_name, '-'), '（', u.username, '）') AS targetName, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, CONCAT('同时持有互斥角色：', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ra.role_name, ' × ', rb.role_name, '（', mx.reason, '）') SEPARATOR '；')) AS detail FROM agri_md_role_mutex mx JOIN agri_md_role ra ON ra.role_code = mx.role_code_a AND ra.del_flag = 0 JOIN agri_md_role rb ON rb.role_code = mx.role_code_b AND rb.del_flag = 0 JOIN agri_md_user_role ua ON ua.role_id = ra.id AND ua.del_flag = 0 JOIN agri_md_user_role ub ON ub.role_id = rb.id AND ub.user_id = ua.user_id AND ub.del_flag = 0 JOIN agri_md_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id AND u.del_flag = 0 WHERE mx.del_flag = 0 AND mx.enabled = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name, u.username, u.tenant_id

SELECT 'ROLE_MENU' AS targetType, CAST(rm.id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT(IFNULL(r.role_name, '角色'), ' → ', IFNULL(m.menu_name, '菜单')) AS targetName, rm.tenant_id AS tenantId, CONCAT('授权已于 ', DATE_FORMAT(rm.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' 到期，绑定仍在') AS detail FROM agri_md_role_menu rm LEFT JOIN agri_md_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN agri_md_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.del_flag = 0 AND rm.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND rm.expire_time <= NOW() UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_ROLE', CAST(ur.id AS CHAR), CONCAT(IFNULL(u.username, '账号'), ' × ', IFNULL(r.role_name, '角色')), ur.tenant_id, CONCAT('授权已于 ', DATE_FORMAT(ur.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' 到期，绑定仍在') FROM agri_md_user_role ur LEFT JOIN agri_md_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN agri_md_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.del_flag = 0 AND ur.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND ur.expire_time <= NOW() ORDER BY targetType, targetId

SELECT 'ROLE_MENU_DUP' AS targetType, CONCAT(rm.role_id, '-', rm.menu_id) AS targetId, CONCAT(IFNULL(r.role_name, '角色'), ' → ', IFNULL(m.menu_name, '菜单')) AS targetName, MAX(rm.tenant_id) AS tenantId, CONCAT('同一绑定重复 ', COUNT(*), ' 条（记录 id：', GROUP_CONCAT(rm.id ORDER BY rm.id SEPARATOR ','), '）') AS detail FROM agri_md_role_menu rm LEFT JOIN agri_md_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN agri_md_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY rm.role_id, rm.menu_id, r.role_name, m.menu_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT 'ROLE_MENU' AS targetType, CAST(rm.id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CONCAT('role_id=', rm.role_id, ' menu_id=', rm.menu_id) AS targetName, rm.tenant_id AS tenantId, CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN '绑定的角色不存在' WHEN r.del_flag = 1 THEN '绑定的角色已删除' WHEN m.id IS NULL THEN '绑定的菜单不存在' ELSE '绑定的菜单已删除' END AS detail FROM agri_md_role_menu rm LEFT JOIN agri_md_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN agri_md_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.del_flag = 0 AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.del_flag = 1 OR m.id IS NULL OR m.del_flag = 1) UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_ROLE', CAST(ur.id AS CHAR), CONCAT('user_id=', ur.user_id, ' role_id=', ur.role_id), ur.tenant_id, CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN '绑定的角色不存在' WHEN r.del_flag = 1 THEN '绑定的角色已删除' WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN '绑定的账号不存在' ELSE '绑定的账号已删除' END FROM agri_md_user_role ur LEFT JOIN agri_md_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN agri_md_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.del_flag = 0 AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.del_flag = 1 OR u.id IS NULL OR u.del_flag = 1) ORDER BY targetType, targetId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agri_md_permission_anomaly (rule_code, anomaly_type, severity, target_type, target_id, target_name, tenant_id, detail, status, first_seen, last_seen, del_flag) VALUES (#{item.ruleCode}, #{item.anomalyType}, #{item.severity}, #{item.targetType}, #{item.targetId}, #{item.targetName}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.detail}, 'OPEN', #{item.firstSeen}, #{item.lastSeen}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE anomaly_type = VALUES(anomaly_type), severity = VALUES(severity), target_name = VALUES(target_name), tenant_id = VALUES(tenant_id), detail = VALUES(detail), status = 'OPEN', resolved_time = NULL, last_seen = VALUES(last_seen), del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE agri_md_permission_anomaly SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_time = NOW() WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_permission_anomaly WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = 'RESOLVED' AND resolved_time >= #{since}
SELECT MAX(last_seen) FROM agri_md_permission_anomaly WHERE del_flag = 0

SELECT r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.del_flag = 0) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_role_menu rm WHERE rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.del_flag = 0) AS permissionCount FROM agri_md_role r WHERE r.del_flag = 0
AND r.tenant_id = CONVERT(#{tenantId} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ORDER BY userCount DESC, r.id ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(x.day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(x.role_creations) AS roleCreations, SUM(x.permission_changes) AS permissionChanges, SUM(x.role_assignments) AS roleAssignments FROM ( SELECT create_time AS day, COUNT(*) AS role_creations, 0 AS permission_changes, 0 AS role_assignments FROM agri_md_role WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY create_time UNION ALL SELECT create_time, 0, COUNT(*), 0 FROM agri_md_operation_log WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND (module LIKE '%权限%' OR module LIKE '%角色%') GROUP BY create_time UNION ALL SELECT create_time, 0, 0, COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_user_role WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY create_time ) x GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(x.day, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
